items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: Was it I, Miss Nat, who had been here so good, who used to play my band then?

ctx.x: I used to enjoy that. When did the piano come into the bands over here? Well I had a piano player.

Was it I, Miss Nat, who had been here so good, who used to play my band then? Then Grace thought it had been so long I couldn't really say. After you got back from school? Oh yeah, but I played with the Supreme Band. When I organized my own band then I got a piano player, you see.

When did you form your own band, do you remember? Before Depression? After Depression? Before we married. We married in the Depression so it must be. You married forty, forty-one years, is that what you said? Forty-one years ago. Forty-one years ago. Forty-one years ago. So it's been a little while ago. That's a long time to say name, huh? Yeah. Who was that on? We can erase it if you want to, don't worry about it. It's just a joke. That's good publicity. No, but you see, that's the behind it. That's true. That's…
